item.title: Ore ga Yamata no Orochi Nara
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Softhouse Sora
  • 発売日: 2014-06-27
  • スコア: 6.37/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 俺がヤマタノオロチなら
  • 英語名: Ore ga Yamata no Orochi Nara

あらすじ

This is the first title by Softhouse SORA. Shouta lives in the beautiful and peaceful port town of Suga-chou with his childhood friend Mai. He enjoys his days together with Mai, her best friend Yuzuno, his classmate Sayuri, respected upperclassman Yukiho, and best buddy Shingo. However, they were caught up in an unexpected event one summer vacation. He felt like that “someone” within him was about to awaken, and he turned into Yamata no Orochi.
